exposure: tranexamic acid (TXA) administration before cesarean section
outcome: total bleeding volume during and after surgery
cohort: 60 women undergoing cesarean section using spinal anesthesia.
finding: Administering 1g of tranexamic acid 15 minutes before cesarean section significantly reduced the total bleeding volume during and after surgery.
mod_finding: Administering tranexamic acid before cesarean section significantly reduced the volume of postpartum hemorrhage during this mode of birth.
